faq.a: Most clients ship their first order about two weeks after signing. Stock arrives in the first week, and we connect your shop and run test orders in the second.

faq.q: Is there a minimum volume or contract length?
faq.a: There is no minimum order volume. After a three-month start period, contracts run month to month with 30 days’ notice.
You pay for storage per pallet, for pick and pack per order, and for shipping at carrier rates. Extras such as kitting or inserts are quoted per job.

faq.q: Which shops and carriers do you connect to?
faq.a: We have ready plugins for Shopify, WooCommerce, Shoprenter and UNAS, and an API for custom shops. Carriers include GLS, DPD, Foxpost, MPL and DHL, plus pallet networks.
We inspect returned parcels within one working day. Sellable items go back on the shelf and your stock updates. Damaged items are photographed and reported to you.

faq.q: Can you handle pallets and bulky goods?
faq.a: Yes. We store pallets and cartons, and we ship parcels, pallets and full loads. For fragile, high-value or temperature-sensitive goods, tell us early so we can plan the handling.
Yes, across the EU with our carrier partners. We prepare the paperwork for other destinations on request.

about.title: About | Fully Logistics
about.description: Meet the warehouse team behind Fully Logistics and see how a working day runs, from inbound trucks to the 2 pm cut-off.

hero.lead: We are a team of warehouse operators who store, pack and ship for webshops and manufacturers, and we report on every step.

story.title: Why we built it
paragraphs: Fully Logistics grew out of a simple observation: good businesses lose evenings and weekends to packing tape and pallet wrap. We built a warehouse where that work is our full-time job.
Today we ship for webshops that launched last month and for manufacturers that supply national retail chains. The routine is the same for both: receive, store, pack, ship, report.

principles.title: We ship what we promise
principles.text: Cut-off times and dispatch windows are written into your agreement, and we report against them.

principles.title: We show our numbers
principles.text: Accuracy, dispatch speed and stock counts reach you every month, including the misses.

principles.title: We tell you early
principles.text: A late truck, a damaged pallet or a stock difference reaches you the same day, with a proposed fix.

principles.title: We keep it simple
principles.text: One contact person, one portal and one price list, so you never chase three departments.

day.title: A working day, hour by hour
day.lead: The rhythm behind the 2 pm cut-off.
steps: Trucks arrive. Inbound goods are unloaded, checked and booked into stock.
Pick waves start for everything confirmed overnight.
Packing is in full swing, with a quality check before every parcel is sealed.
Cut-off. Orders confirmed by now ship today.
Carriers collect parcels and pallets, and tracking goes live.
Returns are inspected and the day’s stock counts are reconciled.
